sections.title: The uniform Turán density of the tetrahedron
sections.abstract: The paper claims that the uniform Turán density of the 3-uniform tetrahedron K_4^(3) is 1/2, answering an Erdős–Sós question from 1982.
sections.claimed_result: The author states that the uniform Turán density of K_4^(3) equals 1/2.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: 3-uniform hypergraphs and the uniform Turán-density problem for K_4^(3).
sections.caveat: New preprint claim; independent proof checking remains necessary.

sections.title: Chowla’s non-vanishing conjecture over F_q(T)
sections.abstract: For q congruent to 1 modulo 8, the authors claim that L(1/2, chi) is nonzero for 100% of imaginary quadratic Dirichlet characters over F_q(T).
sections.claimed_result: A 100% non-vanishing theorem under q ≡ 1 mod 8.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Function-field arithmetic over F_q(T) with q ≡ 1 mod 8.
sections.caveat: Function-field result under a congruence condition; it does not establish the corresponding number-field statement.

sections.title: The asymptotic in Waring’s problem over function fields beyond twice the degree
sections.abstract: The author proves the expected asymptotic, with a power-saving error, for Waring’s problem over F_q[T] when n > 2d and the characteristic exceeds (d−1)^2, with an explicit lower bound on q.
sections.claimed_result: The expected Waring asymptotic holds in the stated range and is generally sharp for uniform targets.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Waring’s problem over F_q[T], n > 2d, characteristic > (d−1)^2, and an explicit q bound.
sections.caveat: The theorem depends materially on characteristic and q conditions.

sections.title: Quantitative Diffusive Limits for Singular Nonlocal Transport
sections.abstract: The paper proves uniform-in-time convergence of a singular nonlocal continuity equation to heat flow at rate O(b^2), with a particle consequence yielding N^(-2/5) under b ~ N^(-1/5).
sections.claimed_result: Uniform-in-time L1 convergence to heat flow at rate Cb^2 and a circle particle bound.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Closed connected Riemannian manifold with smooth positive data; particle theorem on the circle with iid initialization.
sections.caveat: The particle result is specialized to the circle.

sections.title: Fourier decay of Gaussian multiplicative chaos and boundary geometry
sections.abstract: The authors determine Fourier dimensions and sharp decay behavior for Gaussian multiplicative chaos on tori, bounded sets, and hypersurfaces.
sections.claimed_result: Fourier dimensions in every dimension for smooth log-correlated covariance and a new circle proof of a Garban–Vargas conjecture.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Gaussian multiplicative chaos from smooth log-correlated covariances on geometric supports.
sections.caveat: Full regularity and covariance hypotheses require the theorem statements.

sections.title: The Chen–Yang volume conjecture for long integral fillings of fundamental shadow links
sections.abstract: The paper claims the Chen–Yang volume conjecture for sufficiently long integral fillings and derives asymptotics for SO(3) Turaev–Viro and WRT invariants.
sections.claimed_result: Exponential SO(3) Turaev–Viro growth recovers hyperbolic volume, with an explicit WRT leading coefficient.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Fixed marked fundamental-shadow-link exterior and sufficiently long integral Dehn fillings.
sections.caveat: The fixed-exterior and sufficiently-long hypotheses limit immediate generalization.
